statements.t: “In DM1, our Phase 1 trial of DT-818 is evaluating an approach designed to selectively reduce transcription of the mutant DMPK allele, targeting the source of toxic RNA.

Clinical readouts expected in 2027 will help guide these programs as we pursue our vision for the GeneTAC ® platform: to address the underlying causes of serious genetic diseases and deliver meaningful benefits for patients.”
